name: @djs-core/db
description: Native Drizzle database layer for djs-core

scripts.build: bun build index.ts runtime.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external drizzle-orm --external drizzle-orm/* --external postgres --external mysql2 --external @libsql/client --minify
scripts.dev: bun build index.ts runtime.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external drizzle-orm --external drizzle-orm/* --external postgres --external mysql2 --external @libsql/client --watch
